description: This Java interface defines a response type for a 'Thing Query Command' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It aggregates responses that query the state of a 'Thing' and extends other interfaces to include entity and header information.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandResponse
classes.description: A Java interface representing a response for querying a 'Thing's state, extending response and entity integration functionalities.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity information (as JsonValue) within the response, returning the response object for chaining.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders associated with the response, enabling custom headers, returning the response object for chaining.
